blocks.text: NVIDIA is optional and selected by the system profile/add-on policy. Driver branch, firmware and kernel-module requirements are defined by the system profile. The presence of support files does not prove a module loaded or a monitor is attached to that GPU.

Inspect the display controller and its 'Kernel driver in use' line locally. The output can reveal hardware identifiers; redact them before sharing. Check the selected host profile and boot logs if the intended driver is unavailable.

For a Quadro P520, nvidia-smi reporting Driver 580.196.07 and CUDA Version 13.0 describes the driver's CUDA user-mode compatibility, not a CUDA 13 toolkit or the GPU's compile target. Pascal/SM 6.1 uses the legacy Pika 580 branch and CUDA 12.x toolkits. GSP Firmware Version N/A is expected because Pascal does not use GSP.

Do not replace the managed driver branch with arbitrary vendor packages, rebuild drivers from source, or remove module-signature policy to bypass a failure. Driver changes and reboot recovery require an administrator and a known working recovery path.
